layout.tagline: zero-memory — shared memory for coding agents
layout.reason: You received this message because this address is registered on this zero-memory instance.
layout.linkFallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
confirmation.subject: Confirm your email address
confirmation.preview: One confirmation and your account is ready
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
confirmation.body: Confirm that {email} is yours to finish creating your zero-memory account.
confirmation.disclaimer: If you did not create an account, ignore this message — nothing was set up.
recovery.subject: Reset your password
recovery.preview: A link to choose a new password
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: Someone asked to reset the password for {email}. Choose a new one with the link below — it works once.
recovery.disclaimer: If this was not you, ignore this message — your password stays as it is.
emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.preview: Confirm the new address on your account
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.body: A request was made to change the address on your zero-memory account from {email} to {newEmail}. The change takes effect once both addresses confirm it.
emailChange.disclaimer: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this message and the address stays unchanged.
invite.subject: You have been invited to zero-memory
invite.heading: You have been invited
invite.body: {email} was invited to zero-memory. Accept the invitation to set a password and sign in.
invite.disclaimer: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore it.
digest.subject: Your week in zero-memory
digest.preview: What your memory did for you this week
digest.heading: Your week in zero-memory
digest.body: A summary of how your memory was used this week. It reports counts only — no memory content leaves the instance by mail.
